name: Till Death Do Us Part
source:
Your wife, Stella, has 7 days to live - her senses, her sight, eventually her mind. Her final act? Telling you she never loved you, just to spare you the pain of watching her fade away.
And you? You just want to hold her hand through it. But love isn't that simple.

[From [url=https://fromis9.itch.io/till-death-do-us-part]itch.io[/url]]
